question: Identify the southernmost major port of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tuticorin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

• **Tuticorin Port**, also known as V.O. Chidambaranar Port, is the southernmost major port in India.

• It is located in Tamil Nadu and serves as a crucial hub for maritime trade in the region.

• The port handles a variety of cargo including coal, salt, food grains, and petroleum products.

• Tuticorin Port is strategically important due to its proximity to the East-West international sea route.
